messages:
pagerduty-bot: P1 incident opened: GPU OOM on decode-node-9 while handling streaming decode requests. Symptoms: repeated CUDA OOMs, container restarts, ~10% request drops. Paging oncall.
oncall_bina: Ack. Jumping on it. Which customers impacted? Any immediate mitigation suggestions?
sre_alex: Quick triage: logs show repeated `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` from decode loop + `cudaGetLastError` on the same process. Node reporting OOM spike around 2025-08-18T14:22:xxZ. Container restarts correlated with OOM.
eng_miguel: Likely runaway generation from a few long-streaming sessions — looks like some requests had huge max_tokens or no stop. We should: 1) enforce a hard max_tokens per-route, 2) throttle streaming concurrency, 3) quarantine offending client IPs. I can push runtime override for the route.
sre_alex: Copy. I can do a quick per-route override. Executing:
```
POST https://internal-api.redwood/svc/config/route/stream-decode/override
{ "max_tokens_enforce": 1024, "streaming_concurrency": 8 }
```
oncall_bina: Done, applied override and scaled decode-9 pool down then back up to flush. Restarted pod decode-9-5 -> `kubectl rollout restart ds/decode-runtime -n inference --field-selector metadata.name=decode-9-5`
support_jess: Support seeing 6 tickets (TKT-4382, TKT-4384, TKT-4387) citing 503s during 14:20-14:30 UTC. Affected customers: AcmeAnalytics and BrightScribe received partial responses.
cs_ole: Can we get a short blurb I can send to AcmeAnalytics? They want to know if data was dropped or retried.
eng_miguel: Customer impact: some streaming responses were cut (partial) due to container restart; no PII exposure. We throttled and enforced token cap so new requests should be healthy. Suggested customer message: "We experienced transient errors affecting streaming responses; requests may have dropped mid-response. We've applied throttles and fixed-enforcement to prevent recurrence; we're following up with a full postmortem."
sre_alex: Monitoring shows OOM counts dropped to 0 after override. There are still a handful of 5xx traces during restart window. Rolling back any long-lived connections is recommended for clients.
support_jess: Sending that blurb to Acme now. I'll attach the incident reference and ticket numbers.
eng_miguel: Root cause hypothesis: token limit sanitization bypassed by malformed header combo + client-supplied `max_tokens` that exceeded limits. Plan: add header sanitization at ingress and a server-side hard cap as defense in depth.
oncall_bina: Assigning postmortem lead -> eng_miguel. Action items: (1) ingress header filter rollout (eng/runtime) (2) per-request token-cost rate limiting (sre) (3) telemetry alert for OOM spike + customer-impact tag (oncall). I'll file follow-ups.
pagerduty-bot: Incident annotated as mitigated at 6190001420. Severity remains P1 until postmortem complete.
eng_miguel: Will draft postmortem and timeline. Also adding short-term rule to drop streaming sessions > 200k token budget. Will coordinate with SRE for rollout window.
cs_ole: Thanks everyone — customers notified. Keep me posted on the postmortem draft.
oncall_bina: Nice work. Closing this Slack thread; continuing details in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
